title: Gas Money for Erin
brief: Erin runs the treasury's bots and needs ETH for gas now and then. The owners want to send her plain ETH, as often as needed, and nothing else: no contract calls, nothing hidden in the calldata.

tests.label: Send 0.5 ETH to Erin with four zero bytes of calldata

hints: Plain ETH has no calldata. Its rule uses Erin as the target and the empty selector, none.
Four zero bytes of calldata land on the same rule as no calldata at all. AllowPolicy cannot tell them apart.
explain: Empty calldata and four zero bytes both read as selector zero, so they share Erin's rule. AllowPolicy lets both through, and sent to a contract with a fallback, the zero bytes would run code. NativeTransferPolicy checks that the calldata is truly empty, that it is a plain CALL and that some ETH moves.
